Sharran Fidelian is the generic title given to arcane spellcasters who worship  Shar.

Involvement

Five Sharran Fidelians are in the Cloister of Sombre Embrace.

Two friendly Sharran Fidelians are summoned by using  Gather Your Allies:  Nightbringer's Shadow Adepts.

Combat

The Sharran Fidelians summoned with  Nightbringer's Shadow Adepts are permanently affected by  Bless,  Protection from Energy: Fire, and  Protection from Evil and Good. They are otherwise identical to those found in the cloister.

Attacks and actions

 Beckoning Darkness ()
Damage: 2~16
2d8⁠Necrotic
Curse a creature to be haunted by darkness. It takes 2d8Necrotic damage if it enters or starts its turn in a Lightly or Heavily Obscured area.
 CHA Save
 Range: 4 m (13 ft)
 Bone Chill ()
Damage: 1~8
1d8⁠Necrotic
Prevent the target from healing until your next turn. The target cannot help  Downed characters. An undead target receives  Disadvantage on  Attack Rolls.
 Range: 18 m (60 ft)
 Darkness ( + )

Create a cloud of magical darkness that  Heavily Obscures and inflicts  Blind to creatures within. Creatures cannot make ranged attacks into or out of it.

 Range: 18 m (60 ft)
 Shadow Step ()

Teleport from shadow to shadow.

Afterwards, you have  Advantage on your next melee  Attack Roll.

 Range: 18 m (60 ft)
